title: Threat model the portable command service boundary
description: Perform a read-only threat model of the proposed portable command-service API and durable-state boundary. Analyze tenant isolation, authentication context, idempotency abuse, replay, command authorization, payload limits, sensitive data, result access, cancellation races, broker trust, confused-deputy risks, auditability, and provider portability. Return required contract safeguards and open decisions without editing source.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Read-only threat modeling started in parallel with the domain-contract implementation. It is evaluating tenant/principal binding, capability authorization, idempotency abuse, payload safety, state/outbox consistency, worker and broker trust, cancellation races, resource exhaustion, auditability, and provider-specific responsibilities. No source or external state changes are authorized.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Threat model completed. Required core safeguards identified: authenticated immutable caller context; fail-closed per-operation authorization and target registry; tenant/principal/operation-scoped idempotency; bounded canonical request validation with versioned SHA-256 digests; atomic command, idempotency, and dispatch discovery; durable state verification before execution because broker messages are delivery hints only; terminal handling for late delivery after cancellation; payload-free audit events; and uniform non-disclosing authorization failures. Provider-specific AWS and Kubernetes controls remain adapter work.
